summary: More than most people, a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally - you build things that last and carry real weight and you imagine, feel for others, and create - which is exactly why it's easy to coast on.
body: More than most people, a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally - you build things that last and carry real weight and you imagine, feel for others, and create - which is exactly why it's easy to coast on. Disciplined vision realized over time; the task is managing fear.
gift: At your best: you build things that last and carry real weight, and you imagine, feel for others, and create.
shadow: The trap: you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes - or you escape, idealize, or lose your own outline.
integration: Let discipline and limits and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Disciplined vision realized over time; the task is managing fear.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you build things that last and you imagine, feel for others, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
